name: 11126-eagledecode-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the target, with lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B as the EAGLE draft head. The target is an ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- same weights; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- one GPU, unsharded.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, float16. Draft: LlamaForCausalLMEagle, one hidden layer, float16, max_position_embeddings 2048.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 1500 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Prompts 512 +- 128 tokens clamped to [256, 768], generations 768 +- 128 clamped to [512, 1024]; the clamps keep the worst-case request inside the server's 2048-token context. `ignore_eos` is on by default, so every request generates its full sampled length, and radix cache is off, so every prompt is a real prefill.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on one GPU, speculative decoding an 8B model for 64 concurrent streams.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped when this file is read, and the
# engine would then start without something this file declares.

# Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# float16, not the checkpoint's bfloat16: the EAGLE head below is a float16 checkpoint.
dtype: float16
attention-backend: flashinfer

# Capped to match the draft head's max_position_embeddings of 2048, which sglang requires to
# agree with the target's context length. The workload never exceeds 1792 tokens.
context-length: 2048

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 2
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 6
page-size: 16

max-running-requests: 128
mem-fraction-static: 0.75
disable-radix-cache: true
